translations.eng: I have had severe chest pain and fever for two days.
translations.amh: ለሁለት ቀናት ከባድ የደረት ህመም እና ትኩሳት ነበረኝ።
translations.orm: Guyyoota lamaaf dhukkubbiin qomaa cimaanii fi qaama gubaan natti hammaateera.
translations.tir: ንኽልተ መዓልታት ዝጸንሐ ጽኑዕ ናይ ኣፍልቢ ሕማምን ረስንን ነይሩኒ።
translations.som: Waxaan laba maalmood qabay laab xanuun daran iyo qandho xoog leh.

translations.eng: Are you experiencing any vaginal bleeding or labor contractions?
translations.amh: ምንም አይነት የደም መፍሰስ ወይም የምጥ ስሜት ይሰማዎታል?
translations.orm: Dhiigni qaama saalaa dhangala'u yookaan ciniinsuun dhukkubaa si mudateeraa?
translations.tir: ምፍሳስ ደም ወይስ ስምዒት ምጥ የጋጥመክን ኣሎ ዶ?
translations.som: Ma dareemaysaa wax dhiig bax ah ama xanuunka foolasha?

translations.eng: The child has acute shortness of breath and cannot swallow liquids.
translations.amh: ህጻኑ ከፍተኛ የትንፋሽ ማጠር ስላለበት ፈሳሽ ነገር መዋጥ አይችልም።
translations.orm: Daa'imichi hafuura baafachuu baay'ee dadhabeera, dhangala'oos liqimsuu hin danda'u.
translations.tir: እቲ ሕፃን ጽኑዕ ሕጽረት ትንፋስ ስለዘለዎ ፈሳሲ ነገር ምውሓጥ ኣይክእልን እዩ።
translations.som: Ilmaha waxaa haya neef-qabasho daran wax dareere ahna ma liqi karo.

translations.eng: Do not take this medication on an empty stomach.
translations.amh: ይህንን መድሃኒት በባዶ ሆድ በፍጹም እንዳይወስዱ።
translations.orm: Qoricha kana garaa duwwaatti tasuma hin fudhatinaa.
translations.tir: ነዚ መድሃኒት እዚ ብጥሙይ ከብዲ ፈጺምኩም ኣይትውሰድዎ።
translations.som: Daawadan ha ku qaadanin calool madhan.

translations.eng: Inject 15 units of insulin subcutaneously thirty minutes before breakfast.
translations.amh: ቁርስ ከመብላትዎ ሰላሳ ደቂቃ በፊት 15 ዩኒት ኢንሱሊን በቆዳ ስር ይውጉ።
translations.orm: Ciree nyaachuun dura daqiiqaa soddoma dura yuuniitii 15 inasuliinii gogaa jalaan waraanaadhaa.
translations.tir: ቁርሲ ቅድሚ ምብላዕኩም ሰላሳ ደቒቕ ኣቐዲምኩም 15 ዩኒት ኢንሱሊን ኣብ ትሕቲ ቆርበት ተወግኡ።
translations.som: Iska mud 15 unug oo insuliin ah maqaarka hoostiisa soddon daqiiqo ka hor quraacda.

translations.eng: He had an epileptic seizure, bit his tongue, and lost consciousness.
translations.amh: የሚጥል በሽታ አንቀጥቅጦት ምላሱን ነክሶ ራሱን ሳተ።
translations.orm: Dhibeen gaggabdoo qabee arraba isaa ciniinee of wallaale.
translations.tir: ናይ ምጥል ሕማም ሒዝዎ ልሳኑ ነኺሱ ነብሱ ሰሓተ።
translations.som: Suuxdin baa ku dhacday, carabkiisana wuu qaniinay, miyirkana wuu ka tagay.

translations.eng: Are you allergic to penicillin or any other antibiotics?
translations.amh: ለፔኒሲሊን ወይም ለሌሎች አንቲባዮቲኮች አለርጂ አለብዎት?
translations.orm: Paanisiliinii yookaan qorichoota farra-baakteeriyaa biraatiif alarjiin si irra jiraa?
translations.tir: ንፔኒሲሊን ወይስ ንኻልኦት ፀረ-ተህዋስያን ኣለርጂ ኣለኩም ዶ?
translations.som: Xasaasiyad ma ku leedahay daawada baensiliinta ama dawooyinka kale ee antibiyootigga?

translations.eng: My leg is broken and I cannot put any weight on it.
translations.amh: እግሬ ስለተሰበረ ምንም አይነት ክብደት ልጭንበት አልችልም።
translations.orm: Miilli koo waan cabeef ulfaatina homaayyuu irra dhaabbachuu hin danda'u.
translations.tir: እግረይ ስለእተሰብረ ዋላ ሓንቲ ኽብደት ክረግጸሉ ኣይኽእልን እየ።
translations.som: Lugtayda way jabtay wax culeys ahna ma saari karo.

translations.eng: She is suffering from continuous watery diarrhea and severe dehydration.
translations.amh: ተከታታይ የውሃ ተቅማጥ እና ከፍተኛ የሰውነት ፈሳሽ እጥረት አጋጥሟታል።
translations.orm: Albaatiin bishaanii walirraa hin cinneefi qaamni bishaan dhabuun cimaan ishee mudateera.
translations.tir: ቀጻሊ ናይ ማይ ውጽኣትን ጽኑዕ ምውሓድ ፈሳሲ ኣካላትን ኣጋጢምዋ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Waxaa haya shuban biyo ah oo joogto ah iyo fuuq-bax daran.

translations.eng: Take a deep breath and push now!
translations.amh: ረጅሙን ተንፍሺና አሁን አምጪ!
translations.orm: Hafuura dheeraa fudhadhuutii ammumma ciniiniitii dhiibi!
translations.tir: ዕሙቕ ዝበለ ትንፋስ ወሲድኪ ሕጂ ጽዓሪ!
translations.som: Neef dheer qaado oo hadda riix!

literal_trap: stomach burst vs moved to tears

translations.eng: When I heard the tragic news, I was moved to tears.
translations.amh: አሳዛኙን ዜና ስሰማ ሆዴ ባባ።
translations.orm: Oduu gaddisiisaa sana yeroon dhaga'u garaan koo baay'ee na laafe.
translations.tir: ነቲ ዘሕዝን ዜና ምስ ሰማዕኩ ልበይ ሰንበደ።
translations.som: Markii aan warka naxdinta leh maqlay, aad baan uga tiiraanyooday oo ilmeeyay.

literal_trap: grow legs vs ran as fast as possible

translations.eng: When I saw the armed men, I ran as fast as my legs could carry me.
translations.amh: ታጣቂዎቹን ሳያቸው እግር አውጣ ብዬ ሮጥኩ።
translations.orm: Namoota meeshaa qabatan sana yeroon argu miila koo garaatti baadheen fiige.
translations.tir: ነቶም ዕጡቓት ሰባት ምስ ርአኽዎም ብዘለኒ ሓይሊ ሃዲመ።
translations.som: Markii aan arkay ragga hubaysan, xawli daran baan ku cararay.

literal_trap: in standing thing vs speaking seriously

translations.eng: I am speaking to you with all seriousness, do not joke.
translations.amh: በቁም ነገር ነው የማናግርህ፣ አትቀልድ።
translations.orm: Dhugumatti dubbii ulfaataadhaanan sitti himaa jira, hin taphatin.
translations.tir: ብቐንዱ ብዕቱብ እየ ዝዛረበካ ዘለኹ፡ ኣይትዋዘ።
translations.som: Si dhab ah oo miyir leh baan kuula hadlayaa, ha kaftamin.

translations.eng: The room is spinning and I feel very dizzy.
translations.amh: አይኔ እየጨለመ ራሴን እያዞረኝ ነው።
translations.orm: Lafti natti maraa jira, akkasumas sammuun na naanna'aa jira.
translations.tir: ኣዒንተይ እናጸልመተ ርእሰይ የዕዘረኒ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Dunnida ayaa igu wareegaysa aadna waan u wareersanahay.

literal_trap: heart broke vs heart rested / relieved

translations.eng: When I heard that my child was safe, my heart was deeply relieved.
translations.amh: ልጄ ሰላም መሆኑን ስሰማ ልቤ አረፈ።
translations.orm: Mucaan koo nagaa ta'uu yeroon dhaga'u garaan koo tasgabbaa'e.
translations.tir: ውላደይ ድሓን ምህላዉ ምስ ሰማዕኩ ልበይ ዓሪፉ።
translations.som: Markii aan maqlay in ilmahaygii nabad qabo, wadnahaygu wuu degay oo nafi baa igu soo noqotay.

translations.eng: Be strong and stay courageous, everything will be alright.
translations.amh: አይዞህ በርታ፣ ሁሉም ነገር በሰላም ያልፋል።
translations.orm: Jabaadhu garaa jabeeffadhu, wanti hundi nagaan darba.
translations.tir: ኣይትተሓለል ጽናዕ፡ ኵሉ ነገር ብሰላም ክሓልፍ እዩ።
translations.som: Adkayso oo geesi noqo, wax walba way hagaagi doonaane.

translations.eng: Happy holiday and season's greetings to you and your family!
translations.amh: እንኳን ለአዲሱ ዓመት በዓል በሰላም አደረሳችሁ!
translations.orm: Baga ayyaana bara haaraatiin isiniifi maatii keessan nagaan geessan!
translations.tir: እንቋዕ ናብዚ ሓዲሽ ዓመት በዓል ብሰላም ኣብጽሓኩም!
translations.som: Kugu hambalyeeyay munaasabadda ciidda adiga iyo qoyskaagaba!

translations.eng: Thank you very much, and may God bless you with health.
translations.amh: እግዚአብሔር ይስጥልኝ፣ ጤና ይስጥልኝ።
translations.orm: Waaqayyo fayyaa fi umurii siif haa kennu, baay'ee galatoomi.
translations.tir: እግዚኣብሄር ይሃበለይ፡ ጥዕና ይሃበለይ።
translations.som: Ilaahay haku barakeeyo caafimaadna haku siiyo, aad baad u mahadsan tahay.

translations.eng: How much does a quintal of white Magna teff cost today?
translations.amh: ዛሬ የአንድ ኩንታል የነጭ ማኛ ጤፍ ዋጋ ስንት ነው?
translations.orm: Har'a gatiin xaafii adii maangaa kintaala tokkoo meeqa?
translations.tir: ሎሚ ዋጋ ሓደ ኲንታል ጻዕዳ ጣፍ ክንደይ እዩ?
translations.som: Immisaa maanta qiimaha hal kintaal oo ah daafi cad?

translations.eng: This Yirgacheffe washed coffee is of premium grade and very aromatic.
translations.amh: ይህ የታጠበ የይርጋጨፌ ቡና አንደኛ ደረጃ እና እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ መዓዛ ያለው ነው።
translations.orm: Buni Yirgaacaffaa miiccame kun qulqullina olaanaa fi foolii baay'ee gaarii qaba.
translations.tir: እዚ ዝተሓጽበ ናይ ይርጋጨፈ ቡን ቀዳማይ ደረጃን ኣዝዩ ጥዑም ጨና ዘለዎን እዩ።
translations.som: Bunkan Yirgaacheffe ee la dhaqay waa heerka koowaad aadna wuu u caraf badan yahay.

translations.eng: Ten thousand Birr is too expensive; please reduce the price for me.
translations.amh: አስር ሺህ ብር በጣም ውድ ነው፤ እባክዎ ትንሽ ቀንስልኝ።
translations.orm: Birriin kuma kudhan baay'ee mi'aawaadha; maaloo gatii naaf hir'isi.
translations.tir: ዓሰርተ ሽሕ ቅርሺ ኣዝዩ ክቡር እዩ፤ በጃኻ ዋጋ ኣጉድለለይ።
translations.som: Toban kun oo Birr aad bay qaali u tahay; fadlan qiimaha wax iiga dhim.

translations.eng: How much for this fat sheep for the holiday feast?
translations.amh: ለበዓሉ ድግስ የሚሆነው ይህ የሰባ በግ ስንት ነው?
translations.orm: Hoolaan gabbataaniifi nyaata ayyaanaatiif ta'u kun gatiin isaa meeqa?
translations.tir: ንበዓል ድግሲ ዝኸውን እዚ ዝሰበሐ በጊዕ ክንደይ ዋግኡ?
translations.som: Idahan buuran ee diyaarka u ah munaasabadda ciidda waa immisa?

translations.eng: Do you accept digital payments through Telebirr or mobile banking?
translations.amh: በቴሌብር ወይም በሞባይል ባንኪንግ ክፍያ ትቀበላላችሁ?
translations.orm: Kaffaltii dijitaalaa karaa Telee-birrii yookaan baankii mobaayilaatiin ni fudhattuu?
translations.tir: ብቴሌብር ወይስ ብሞባይል ባንኪንግ ክፍሊት ትቕበሉ ዶ?
translations.som: Ma aqbashaa lacag-bixinta casriga ah ee Telebirr ama bangiga mobaylka?

translations.eng: What time does the morning cross-country bus leave for Bahir Dar?
translations.amh: የጠዋቱ የሀገር አቋራጭ አውቶቡስ ወደ ባህር ዳር ስንት ሰዓት ይነሳል?
translations.orm: Otobisii ganamaa gara Baahir Daar deemu sa'aatii meeqatti ka'a?
translations.tir: ናይ ንግሆ ኣውቶቡስ ናብ ባሕሪ ዳር ክንደይ ሰዓት ይብገስ?
translations.som: Baska aroortii ee gobollada u socda Bahir Dar goormuu baxayaa?

translations.eng: The monolithic rock-hewn churches of Lalibela were built in the twelfth century.
translations.amh: ከአንድ ወጥ አለት የተፈለፈሉት የላሊበላ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት የተገነቡት በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን ነው።
translations.orm: Manni sagadaa dhagaa qullaa irraa hojjetamee Laallibalaa jaarraa kudha lammaffaa keessa ijaarame.
translations.tir: ካብ ሓደ ከውሒ ዝተወቕሩ ኣብያተ-ክርስትያን ላሊበላ ኣብ መበል ዓሰርተው ክልተ ክፍለ-ዘመን ዝተሃነጹ እዮም።
translations.som: Kaniisadaha taariikhiga ah ee dhagaxa laga qoday ee Lalibela waxaa la dhisay qarnigii laba iyo tobnaad.

translations.eng: Axum is renowned worldwide for its ancient stelae and rich historical heritage.
translations.amh: አክሱም በጥንታዊ ሀውልቶቿ እና በታላቅ ታሪካዊ ቅርሶቿ በመላው ዓለም ትታወቃለች።
translations.orm: Magaalaan Aksum siidaa duriifi seenaa qabeessa ta'een addunyaa gutuurratti beekamti.
translations.tir: ኣኽሱም ብጥንታውያን ሓወልትታታን ብሃብታም ታሪኻዊ ውርሻታታን ኣብ መላእ ዓለም ፍልጥቲ እያ።
translations.som: Magaalada Axum waxay dunida oo dhan ku caanbaxday tiirarka qadiimiga ah iyo dhaxalka taariikhiga ah.

translations.eng: Turn right at the roundabout and continue straight past the grand mosque.
translations.amh: አደባባዩ ጋር ወደ ቀኝ ታጥፈው ታላቁን መስጊድ አልፈው ቀጥታ ይሂዱ።
translations.orm: Rundabootti gara mirgaatti goriitii masgiida guddicha bira darbiitii qajeeli.
translations.tir: ኣብቲ ኣደባባይ ናብ የማን ተጠዊኹም ነቲ ዓቢ መስጊድ ሓሊፍኩም ብቐጥታ ኺዱ።
translations.som: U leexo dhinaca midig wareegga kaddibna si toos ah u dhaaf masaajidka weyn.

translations.eng: I lost my Kebele identification card and need a replacement certificate.
translations.amh: የቀበሌ መታወቂያ ካርዴ ስለጠፋብኝ ምትክ ማስረጃ እፈልጋለሁ።
translations.orm: Waraqaan eenyummaa gandaa koo waan na jalaa badeef ragaa bakka bu'u nan barbaada.
translations.tir: መለለዪ ወረቐት ቀበለ ስለዝጠፍኣኒ መተካእታ ምስክር ወረቐት የድልየኒ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Waxaa iga lumay kaarkii aqoonsiga xaafadda (kebele) waxaanan u baahanahay caddeyn bedel ah.

translations.eng: I want to file a police report because my passport and phone were stolen.
translations.amh: ፓስፖርቴ እና ስልኬ ስለተሰረቁ የፖሊስ ሪፖርት ማቅረብ እፈልጋለሁ።
translations.orm: Paaspoortiin koofi bilbilli koo waan jalaa hatameef gabaasa poolisiitti kennuun barbaada.
translations.tir: ፓስፖርተይን ሞባይለይን ስለእተሰርቁ ሓበሬታ ናብ ፖሊስ ከቕርብ እደሊ ኣለኹ።
translations.som: Waxaan rabaa inaan dacwad boolis gudbiyo maadaama baasaboorkeygii iyo taleefankeygii la xaday.

translations.eng: Please sit down, sir, and make yourself comfortable.
translations.amh: እባክዎትን ጋሼ ይቀመጡ፣ እንደ ልብዎ ይሁኑ።
translations.orm: Maaloo kabajamoo taa'aa, akkuma mana keessaniitti boqodhaa.
translations.tir: በጃኹም ኣቦይ ተቐመጡ፡ ከም ድላይኩም ድማ ፍቱሓት ኩኑ።
translations.som: Fadlan fariiso mudane, oo si fiican u raaxayso.

translations.eng: Welcome, sister, how is your health today?
translations.amh: እንኳን ደህና መጣሽ እህቴ፣ ዛሬ ጤናሽ እንዴት ነው?
translations.orm: Baga nagaan dhufte obboleettii ko, har'a fayyaan kee akkam?
translations.tir: እንቋዕ ድሓን መጻእኺ ሓፍተይ፡ ሎሚ ጥዕናኺ ከመይ ኣሎ?
translations.som: Ku soo dhawoow abaayo, caafimaadkaagu maanta sidee yahay?

translations.eng: If the doctor had arrived ten minutes earlier, the surgery would have succeeded.
translations.amh: ዶክተሩ አስር ደቂቃ ቀድሞ ደርሶ ቢሆን ኖሮ ቀዶ ጥገናው ይሳካ ነበር።
translations.orm: Doktoorichi daqiiqaa kudhan dursitee utuu dhufeera ta'ee, yaalli baqaqsanii hodhuu sun ni milkaa'a ture.
translations.tir: እቲ ሓኪም ዓሰርተ ደቒቕ ኣቐዲሙ መጺኡ እንተዝነብር፡ እቲ መጥባሕቲ ምሰለኸ ነይሩ።
translations.som: Haddii dhakhtarku toban daqiiqo ka hor iman lahaa, qalliinku wuu guuleysan lahaa.
